ambiguity_policy: Retain UNCLASSIFIED unless the available frozen evidence supports a deterministic classification.

categories.UNCLASSIFIED: A mismatch for which the frozen evidence does not support a narrower deterministic attribution.
categories.currency normalization: Currency representations differ semantically or canonically; no compatible CORD currency field is present.
categories.date normalization: Date representations differ semantically or canonically; no compatible CORD date field is present.
categories.duplicate item: An item is repeated beyond its ground-truth multiplicity; not separately attributable from pathless list leaves in this table.
categories.hierarchy / line-item alignment: Correct or near-correct values are assigned to the wrong repeated line-item structure; not safely attributable when row indices are intentionally ignored.
categories.incorrect value: Both truth and prediction are present but differ without a supported narrower normalization or substring classification.
categories.missing field: A ground-truth leaf is absent from the prediction multiset.
categories.numeric normalization: A monetary/numeric value matches after deterministic punctuation normalization but not exact normalized text.
categories.OCR corruption: An error demonstrably attributable to an OCR trace; unavailable for end-to-end Donut rows without a separate OCR trace.
categories.partial string mismatch: One normalized string contains the other but they are not exact.
categories.reconciliation contradiction: Extracted monetary fields violate a deterministic subtotal/tax/total relationship.
categories.schema failure: The generated output cannot be parsed into the expected schema.
categories.security/control intervention: A security boundary blocks or sanitizes untrusted instructions; reported separately in frozen V3 security evidence.
categories.serving/runtime failure: A request fails or does not return a usable response; none occurred in the controlled robustness runs study.
categories.spurious field: A predicted leaf has no matching ground-truth leaf at that path and multiplicity.
